scope: Route review for skipping FG and prioritizing ray tracing on L4D2/DXVK/Arc B580; no renderer implementation or hardware test
constraints: Aim to retain 60 real frames; later external 2x FG optional
Avoid assuming entire game must be single-threaded
findings: FG is not a prerequisite for ray tracing. A single-frame/static RT visibility experiment avoids previous/current correspondence and FG scheduling, but full RT requires more complete scene data.
Current collection of final/HUDless color, depth and inferred cameras is not a complete RT scene. Geometry, deformation, materials, lights and stable instance identities are missing or not proven.

l4d2-rtx compatibility code forces mat_queue_mode=0, r_threaded_particles=0, r_threadeddetailprops=0 and mat_softwareskin=1; this affects render concurrency/skinning but does not mean every game subsystem is single-threaded.

Pinned current Remix uses required KHR acceleration-structure, ray-query, ray-tracing-pipeline and buffer-device-address extensions; examined NV interop and invocation-reorder extensions are optional.
Pinned Remix context falls back from unsupported DLSS to TAAU and disables unsupported DLFG. These code paths do not prove B580 runtime compatibility or performance.
The reviewed current Remix commit differs from the bridge baseline and original reference lock. A matching package/API/bridge combination must be validated; no drop-in compatibility claim.

routes.name: Existing l4d2-rtx with matching Remix runtime
routes.role: First compatibility/quality/performance baseline to evaluate when RT is the goal
risks: PBR material, lights, transparency and addon coverage

routes.name: Original raster plus bounded hardware RT effect
routes.role: Preferred bounded research fallback if retaining high-pressure 60 is more important than full scene relighting
first_scope: Correct BLAS/TLAS and ray-hit debug view
One selected AO/visibility or light-shadow effect
Explicit composition that avoids blindly multiplying baked final lighting
risks: Still requires true geometry and reliable classification
Missing dynamic/alpha-tested occluders must be treated as a known limit
Denoising and GPU budget still need measurement

routes.name: Full custom Vulkan path tracer
routes.role: Highest new engineering burden; not recommended as the first route
risks: Scene extraction, GPU skinning, materials, lights, denoising, temporal history, pacing and lifecycle

routes.name: Screen-space SSR/SSGI effects
routes.limit: Does not substitute for full-scene hardware RT; offscreen geometry is absent

recommended_gates: Test hardware RT features and an existing matching RT runtime/compatibility baseline on B580 without FG; record errors and CPU/GPU costs.
If full existing RT works, assess original versus RT high-pressure source FPS before investing in a custom renderer.
If existing RT is unsuitable, first prove static scene geometry and correct ray hits in a bounded hybrid path. Do not automatically start a full custom renderer.
Only then add one defined effect, denoising, dynamic occluders, materials and high-pressure performance acceptance.
difficulty: A static/limited RT milestone can be easier to verify than general FG; complete playable RT is a larger scene/rendering project and is not established as easier. No delivery date is inferred.
